title: Correct time interval
description: Essential: The student correctly identifies that the time between marks corresponds to half the vibration period, yielding T = 0.1 s.

title: Acceleration calculation
description: Important: The student correctly applies the kinematics relation for displacement difference in equal time intervals to find the plate's acceleration (a = 1 m/s²).

title: Velocity at point A
description: Important: The student correctly calculates the average velocity over the interval OA (or uses appropriate kinematics) to find v_A = 0.2 m/s.

title: Final time answer
description: Essential: The student provides the correct numerical answer for the time when power is connected: 0.1 s.

title: Final speed answer
description: Essential: The student provides the correct numerical answer for the plate's speed when power is turned on: 0.1 m/s.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student demonstrates consistent unit conversion (cm to m) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses the sign for acceleration (e.g., treats upward acceleration as negative) leading to wrong velocity or time.

title: Misinterpreting trace intervals
description: Pitfall: The student assumes the time between marks O, A, B, C is a full period instead of half, leading to incorrect T.
